title: Replace Day N with calendar date and phone-style timestamps across The Commons

sections.what: Replace Day N labels (such as 'Day 1, 08:01') in The Commons message feed, inner drawer, backend character context, and Commons agent prompts with real calendar dates and phone-style timestamps (e.g. '23:02' with date dividers like 'Fri, Oct 14, 2016', and 'Fri Oct 14, 2016 23:02' in prompts).
sections.why: Having a phone chat app display 'Day 1, 08:01' looks like a board-game turn counter instead of a messaging app, breaking immersion in both connected Viwo texting and standalone Commons RP.
sections.how:
1. Expose VirtualWorld's existing calendar date (game_year, game_month, game_day) in routes/commons.py world_clock and character_context.
2. Update formatWorldTick in static/js/commons/commons-ui.ts (and shared time helper) to format phone-style timestamps using the world calendar or standalone anchored datetime, with date headers when days change and HH:MM on messages.
3. Update routes/commons.py character_context world_time and read_chat sent_time formatting to emit calendar date + HH:MM instead of 'Day N'.
4. Update static/js/commons/commons-agent.ts prompt clock and drawer turn history timestamps to match.
5. Update tests/test_commons.py and tools/unit/test_commons_agent.js.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_commons.py, npm run build:ts, and node tools/unit/run.cjs test_commons_agent; verify in browser on /commons that feed, drawer, and agent prompts show calendar date/time with zero 'Day N' strings.

acceptance.text: Commons feed messages and inner drawer timestamps render phone-style HH:MM and calendar dates instead of 'Day N'.
routes/commons.py world_time and read_chat sent_time use calendar dates instead of 'Day N'.
Zero 'Day N' counter strings remain in The Commons UI or agent prompts.

sections.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: /commons message feed, date dividers, and character inner drawer.

Manual verification steps:
1. Open http://localhost:4444/commons and send a message / trigger a turn.
2. Inspect message timestamps and the character inner drawer footer.
   - expected: Shows HH:MM and calendar date (e.g. Oct 14, 2016 or Nov 16), never 'Day 1'.
